cluster: twin-risk-engine: PERT/severity distributions, empirical anchoring, response pricing, ensemble trade-off, constraint pre-filter, causal admission, Buhlmann-Straub credibility, information regimes, and the forecast-book benchmark/blind-scoring harness

modules.purpose: PERT triples (min/mode/max), their analytic Beta-distribution moments, seeded Monte-Carlo sampling, and the calibration-procedure pin that every sampled artefact cites by digest.
modules.key_functions: Triple (frozen dataclass: mean, variance, shape->(alpha,beta), raw_moment(k), sample(rng), times(), scaled(), moments()); quantise() (12-sig-fig rounding, refuses non-finite); procedure() (reads calibration.md, requires 5 named steps by regex, returns sha256 pin); stream(seed) (named random.Random); sampler() (metadata block); summarise(draws) (nearest-rank p05/p50/p95 over a Monte-Carlo run)
modules.depends_on: twin/__init__.py (PACKAGE_DIR), twin/canon.py (sha256_hex); calibration.md as an external required document

modules.purpose: Heavy-tailed severity model: lognormal body spliced continuously to a Generalised Pareto Distribution (GPD) tail at an authored peaks-over-threshold cut; VaR and closed-form TVaR (expected shortfall).
modules.key_functions: Severity (frozen dataclass: tail_probability [derived from lognormal body, never a second authored number], survival(x), cdf(x), _quantile(p) shared by var/sample, var(alpha), tvar(alpha) [closed-form McNeil&Frey, refuses when VaR falls in the lognormal body or when xi>=1], sample(rng), loss_exceedance_curve(alphas)); module-level _lognormal_survival/_quantile, _gpd_survival/_quantile

modules.purpose: Versioned empirical anchoring data for severity.py's model, subject 'data-breach-loss': two cited quantiles (median $600k, p95 $32M from Cyentia IRIS 2025), from which mu/sigma are fit and threshold is cited; xi (0.6) and beta ($15M) are marked anchored:false with a stated reason each.

Loads/validates severity-anchors.yaml, fits the lognormal body from two cited quantiles by exact closed-form two-point calibration, builds a Severity per subject, and reports a sensitivity sweep over the unanchored xi.
modules.key_functions: fit_lognormal(p1,x1,p2,x2) (closed-form, refuses equal probabilities or non-positive/decreasing quantiles); Anchored (dataclass wrapping Parameter list + Severity); load() (@lru_cache, validates schema/subjects/quantiles/parameters, requires anchored params to name a method and unanchored ones to name a reason); pin(); subject_ids(); anchored(subject_id) (recomputes mu/sigma/threshold from cited quantiles every call rather than trusting stored numbers); sensitivity(subject_id, alpha, grid) (sweeps xi only, holds mu/sigma/threshold/beta fixed, reports min/max TVaR across the grid)

modules.purpose: Joins the causal propagation layer to money: prices every impact a shock causes under one perspective's declared valuation x propagated influence, three-gates it (path evidence grade, valuation evidence grade, causal admission to a declared cash flow), and scores mitigation credit for responses gated on both evidence grade and corroborated enactment.
modules.key_functions: impacts(graph,perspective,origin) (runs propagate.propagate, admission.admit per component, returns priced/register/traversal); _priced_triple(amount,influence) (exact point-wise scaling, no re-sampling); _credit(option,claim,priced,overlay) (mitigation credit gated on claim evidence grade AND corroboration.state()'s enactment check, else a named refusal); price(graph,perspective,origin,responses,overlay) (top-level: runs options.prefilter().priced() first, attaches mitigation to each admitted response, asserts closed body); refuse_undeclared_keys/refuse_unpriced_figures (structural invariants: a register entry or refused claim never carries a number, not even zero); spread(figures)
modules.depends_on: twin/admission.py, twin/corroboration.py, twin/evidence.py, twin/options.py, twin/propagate.py, twin/artefact.py, twin/canon.py, twin/pert.py (Triple, quantise)

modules.purpose: Computes net cost of risk (authored cost minus causal-account-dependent credit) for every admitted response, across a named ensemble of rival causal accounts, side by side per account, plus a computed (never asserted) cheapest-by-account agreement check and a mean-based default.
modules.key_functions: _net(entry) (cost.mode - credit.mode, point-wise); curve(overlay,perspective,origin,responses,account_ids) (calls pricing.price() once per named account unmodified, needs >=2 accounts); _assemble(...) (pure function: per-option rows with min/max/range across accounts, cheapest_by_account, unanimous flag, default = lowest mean net cost); _own_shape/_blank_account_keyed_maps/refuse_undeclared_keys (closes this module's own vocabulary separately from pricing's, excluding data-keyed maps like by_account)
modules.depends_on: twin/pricing.py (price), twin/model.py (Overlay, ModelError), twin/canon.py, twin/artefact.py, twin/pert.py (quantise)

modules.purpose: The constraint pre-filter and the sole gateway to pricing a response's cost: removes options that cross a constraint in force before any pricing runs (a constraint is not a very large price), structurally locked so pricing can only ever be called as a method on the object the pre-filter produced.
modules.key_functions: Option.of(doc); Admitted (frozen dataclass, __post_init__ refuses construction unless made_by is the module-private _FROM_THE_PREFILTER sentinel; _refuse_a_broken_partition() re-derives the filter from the constraint set and refuses if a copy disagrees, defending against dataclasses.replace()); Admitted.priced(seed,draws) (samples each surviving option's cost via PERT, asserts body closure and no priced removals); prefilter(perspective,responses) (reads constraints.resolve() only, holds no list of its own, never inspects cost); refuse_undeclared_keys/refuse_priced_removals (REMOVAL_KEYS closed to 9 string-only fields, plus a numeric-value scan)
modules.depends_on: twin/constraints.py (resolve), twin/pert.py (procedure, sampler, stream, summarise, Triple), twin/artefact.py, twin/canon.py

modules.purpose: Loads and validates the two-tier constraint set (universal floor + perspective red lines), scope exclusions, and four named design positions; resolves the set in force for a perspective and refuses any attempt to override a floor id.
modules.key_functions: load() (@lru_cache, validates schema, floor non-empty with >=1 ruin-class entry, scope_exclusions non-empty, four REQUIRED_POSITIONS present with exact status); pin(); floor()/floor_ids(); published() (full artefact body: floor+exclusions+positions); declared_by(perspective) (perspective's own forbidden/ruin constraints); resolve(perspective) (floor always first, never filtered by the perspective); refuse_floor_override(perspective) (refuses if perspective declares an id the floor already holds); artefact(command) (AUTHORED-mark Artefact, no capability/depth grade since it's a human declaration)
modules.depends_on: twin/__init__.py (PACKAGE_DIR), twin/canon.py (digest_of); twin/artefact.py, twin/evidence.py (lazy import inside artefact()); yaml

modules.purpose: The universal floor (5 constraints: no special-category representation, no covert sensing, no individual attribution, no individual-level output, no automatic enactment, no-ruin-class-option), 5 scope exclusions (power-asymmetry, harms to non-contracting parties, disparate-impact measurement, the twin's own liability, individual behaviour), and 4 positions (no-power-layer/stated, exit-cost-asymmetry/unsolved, reflexivity-and-goodhart/deferred, covert-sensing/permanently-excluded).

Derives (never authors) whether an impact enters the £: only when a causal path, graded at or inside the admission threshold, reaches a cash flow the perspective itself declared, or the component is itself a declared cash flow.
modules.key_functions: cash_flows(perspective); compact(verdict) (drops duplicated gating blocks from a refusal, keeps the blast radius); admit(graph,perspective,component) (checks declared cash-flow membership first, then runs blast.radius() traversal gated at the admission threshold and looks for a declared cash flow among admitted_to_pricing entries; refusal carries the full blast_radius as its own first-class answer)
modules.depends_on: twin/blast.py (radius), twin/evidence.py (admission_threshold, pin), twin/model.py (Graph, lazy import for ModelError)

modules.purpose: Buhlmann-Straub credibility blending: Z-weighted combination of an org's own sparse data with the world-layer industry prior triple, where Z rises with own-data volume and world-prior variance, falls with own-data variance; the industry triple's width is never narrowed, only its mode is translated.
modules.key_functions: variance(values) (sample variance, n-1 divisor, 0.0 for <2 points); credibility_z(n,own_variance,world_variance) (Z=n/(n+K), K=own/world variance; degenerate-world-variance checked before degenerate-own-variance so a certain industry prior is immovable); Blend (dataclass: as_dict() reports own_component/world_component split); blend(subject,industry,observations) (top-level: computes Z, shifts the whole triple by z*(own_mean-industry.mode), reports k=None when either variance is degenerate/zero)

modules.purpose: The three information regimes (as-consumed / as-knowable / with-hindsight) that gate a scenario's forecast inputs by construction (facts absent from the overlay, not merely flagged), plus the computed sensing/interpretation gap between regimes and a refusal when a redacted fact is bound to the scenario's own subject.
modules.key_functions: cutoff(at) (refuses any execution time not YYYY-MM-DD, since dates are compared as strings); require(regime) (no default -- refuses None); ingestion_history(repo,at) (attempts ModelRepo.open_at_time, reports availability rather than silently degrading as-consumed to date-only filtering); read_at(repo,org,regime,at,loaded) (opens a real past repo state for as-consumed via rewind, not a filtered view of HEAD); apply(overlay,regime,at,history) (removes withheld facts from the overlay by dataclasses.replace, drops claims whose signal was withheld, reports withheld/orphaned/admitted); refuse_redacted_subject(report,overlay,components,where) (AC3: refuses to run rather than silently answer a different question when a withheld post-T fact is bound to a component the scenario forecasts); gap(reports) (computes sensing gap [as-knowable minus as-consumed] and interpretation gap [with-hindsight minus as-knowable] as explicit fact-id sets; model_residual explicitly reports computed:False with a stated reason -- nothing yet infers a probability from a signal)
modules.depends_on: twin/model.py (Overlay), twin/repo.py (ModelRepo, RepoError), twin/schema.py (DATED_FACTS, REGIMES); dataclasses, re (stdlib)

modules.purpose: Blind, pinned, signed forecast emission (before a question's resolution window opens) and proper-scoring-rule resolution scoring against the exact pinned emission; a deliberately closed 3-function public surface (emit/score_resolution/is_blind) so no position-placing function can hide under a different name.
modules.key_functions: is_blind(emitted_at,resolution_window_opens_at) (strict string comparison of fixed-width UTC timestamps, recomputable by an auditor from just the artefact body); emit(caps,question,world_model,probability,emitted_at,command) (refuses probability outside open (0,1), refuses malformed timestamps, refuses emission at-or-after the resolution window opens; returns a DERIVED Artefact carrying observe_only:True, position_placed:False, CLAIM_SCOPE); score_resolution(caps,emission_doc,emission_sha256,observed,command) (refuses a non-emission artefact kind, re-checks is_blind against the presented emission's own recorded timestamps, calls scoring.score() -- never reimplements it -- and reads question id/timestamps only from the emission's own pins/body, never fresh parameters)
modules.depends_on: twin/artefact.py (Artefact, DERIVED), twin/canon.py (digest_of), twin/grades.py (Capabilities), twin/scoring.py (score, RULES); re (stdlib)

modules.purpose: Mechanical, versioned, pre-registered benchmark question selection (liquidity/horizon/category filter + deterministic seeded volume-valve sampling), a substring-scan ingestion-quarantine audit proving no benchmarked question id leaked into ingestion provenance, and a proportionality verdict (yes/conditional/no) computed from what has actually been delivered.
modules.key_functions: SelectionRule.load()/digest() (validates required keys, non-empty confidence_bins, positive max_questions); eligible(rule,question) (resolvable-terms filter, no interpretation); select_questions(rule,pool) (sorts by id before filtering so arrival order never matters; volume valve draws deterministically from rule.sample_seed only once candidates exceed max_questions); confidence_distribution()/BenchmarkSet.spans_full_confidence_range() (every declared bin present, zero included, spans checked as a structural fact not asserted in prose); benchmark_set_artefact() (DERIVED artefact, pins rule version/digest + pool digest); audit_quarantine(benchmark,ingestion_records) (json.dumps each record whole and substring-scans for every quarantined id, no timestamp read so lag never matters); quarantine_audit_artefact(); proportionality_verdict(caps,rule,benchmark,resolved,command) (three-word verdict -- no/conditional/yes -- each earned by a structural fact: empty set, set not spanning every bin, or set spanning every bin; cadence reported as designed vs measured depending on len(resolved))
modules.depends_on: twin/forecast_book.py (CLAIM_SCOPE), twin/artefact.py (DERIVED, Artefact), twin/canon.py (digest_of), twin/grades.py (Capabilities), twin/__init__.py (PACKAGE_DIR); yaml, json, random (stdlib)

modules.purpose: The committed, versioned mechanical selection rule: min_liquidity 50000.0, horizon 7-365 days, categories [macro, geopolitics, technology, corporate-outcome, regulatory], 6 confidence bins spanning [0,1], max_questions 40, sample_seed 20260812.

notes: This cluster is the £-engine/risk-quantification core: uncertainty (pert.py) and heavy-tailed severity (severity.py/anchoring.py) feed into pricing (pricing.py) which is reached only through the constraint pre-filter (options.py/constraints.py) and causal admission (admission.py); tradeoff.py composes pricing across rival causal accounts; credibility.py is a separate Bayesian-blending capability not wired into pricing.py in this file set (no cross-reference found between credibility.py and pricing.py/tradeoff.py); regimes.py and forecast_book.py/benchmark.py form a distinct 'epistemic honesty' subsystem (temporal information gating and blind external forecast scoring) that does not touch the £ engine at all -- both subsystems share only the pert.py/canon.py/artefact.py substrate. Every module in this cluster follows the same 'refusal is an answer, never a silent zero/default' discipline, enforced by closed-vocabulary body checks (walk_keys) rather than convention.
